result.title: A Control-Theoretic Approximation to Predictive Coding Dynamics
result.summary: Backpropagation remains the dominant method for training deep neural networks, but its reliance on non-local computations has motivated the search for biologically plausible alternatives. Two prominent frameworks, predictive coding (PC) and deep feedback control (DFC), offer distinct approaches to local learning, yet their relationship remains unclear. Here, we show that DFC arises as a local approximation to predictive coding dynamics near fixed points, with exact equivalence in shallow linear networks and systematic deviations arising with depth, nonlinearity, and distance from equilibrium. We characterize how this approximation, which we call Approx PC, deviates from PC in its activity dynamics, and show that these deviations can be mitigated by relinearizing the feedback controller and approaching the output target through a sequence of intermediate nudges. In networks trained on MNIST and FashionMNIST, Approx PC reaches task performance comparable to PC trained with the same nudges, and weights learned with it transfer directly to PC inference. Our results unify energy-based and control-theoretic perspectives on learning and open the door to applying tools from control theory to the training of predictive coding networks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文比较预测编码（PC）与深度反馈控制（DFC）两种局部学习框架，论证 DFC 是 PC 活性动力学在不动点附近的局部近似（Approx PC），浅层线性网络下精确等价，随深度、非线性与远离平衡而系统偏离；并表明通过重线性化反馈控制器、以序列中间 nudge 逼近输出目标可缓解偏离，在 MNIST/FashionMNIST 上达到与 PC 相当的性能且学到的权重可直接迁回 PC 推断。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把推断写成受反馈控制的不动点迭代，并对收敛步数、nudge 序列与偏离程度给出刻画，可能为 LVR 中循环 latent 状态的更新规则与停止决策提供方法线索，尤其可供核查多步「逼近目标」式更新是否对应 THINK 阶段的计算分配；但论文任务是分类训练而非视觉推理，迁移需自行判断。
